queries: Saved summary; six uniform state matrices; four exact single-outcome visibility classifications; two 101-digit-denominator visibility states; nine support conditions; all physical uniform states exported and ranked; guarded first/middle/last ranks for other conditions.
conditioning: Noiseless physical/pure/nonphysical and support restrictions; full visibility1/4 and1/2 slices; size-six3/4 slice; size-four2/3 slice inside outcomes0..7; impossible noiseless singleton-support family.
banking: Requests before execution; complete outputs and all caches/work immediately after every success. Outer catch retains actual pending request and state. No selection scheduled for zero count.
result_checkpoint: Serialize complete evidence as compact JSON. If larger than2MiB, losslessly split its classification cache into chunks of128 records plus a complete remainder manifest before native checkpoint. Each chunk is planned before writes; no computation is replayed.
limits: Only the queried rational visibility slices are summarized numerically. The saved polynomials support other rational queries; no interval-wide threshold or spectrum-root computation is claimed.
